reason: A cross-conversation memory plugin that stores durable user, agent, and topic notes, injects selected content into session prompts, and provides model and GUI tools for maintenance.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨对话持久记忆，将用户、代理和主题笔记注入会话，并支持通过工具和可视化面板维护。
summaries.en: Provides cross-conversation persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness, injecting selected user, agent, and topic notes into sessions with tool and GUI-based maintenance.

capabilities: Persists structured memory in local Markdown files
Injects stored memory and topic indexes into each session system prompt
Provides a model-visible tool to add, replace, remove, and list memory entries
Provides a GUI for browsing and editing memory through a local HTTP API
